text: FCLoopSamePropagatorHeadsQ[exp] returns True if the FeynAmpDenominator of exp contains only propagator denominators of the same type (e.g. only StandardPropagatorDenominator or only CartesianPropagatorDenominator).
FeynAmpDenominatorCombine[CFAD[q, q - p] SFAD[l, l + k]] FCLoopSamePropagatorHeadsQ[%]
